common.droppedWritesSubtitle: Changes this device queued while offline that were abandoned before they reached the database.
common.dropNoneBody: Every change this device queued offline has either synced or is still waiting to retry. There is nothing to review here.
common.dropHintRetriesExhausted: Syncing failed five times in a row, so the action was removed from the queue. Retry to queue it again.
common.dropHintNoHandler: No handler was registered for this action type, so it was dropped on the first pass. Retry after the app has been updated.
common.dropHintDocumentMissing: The record this change targeted was deleted or was never created, so it could not be applied. Retry only if that record exists again.
common.dropHintUnrecoverable: This change was aimed at a reference that only ever existed on this device, so no retry could reach it. The record uploads with this change already inside it; retry only if it is still missing afterwards.
common.dropEvictedNotice_one: {{count}} older dropped write was trimmed from this log to keep it within its limit.

common.dropRequeuedBody: {{type}} is queued again and will sync on the next pass.
common.dropRequeueFailedBody: The write is still listed here, so nothing has been lost twice. Try again.
common.dropDismissedBody: {{type}} was removed from the dropped-writes log without retrying.
common.dropClearedBody: Every dropped write was dismissed. Data that already synced is untouched.
common.queueMirrorUnavailable: Offline queues are kept in a single copy — the durable backup store is not available in this browser.
common.printServerNotDetected: Local print server not detected. Tickets and receipts will open using the browser print dialog.

backup.fullDesc: Download a restore-ready JSON snapshot of every collection: settings, users, customers, debts, inventory, repairs, sales, purchasing, approvals, logs and daily reports.
backup.securityDesc: Snapshots are generated client-side from your authenticated session and saved to your own downloads folder. No third-party server is contacted.
backup.partialDesc: These collections could not be read and are empty in the file: {{names}}. Do not trust this backup until they export cleanly.
backup.emptyRefused: No collection could be read ({{names}}). Nothing was downloaded — sign in with an account that has Firestore access and export again.
backup.modulesDesc: Export individual store datasets formatted for spreadsheets (CSV) or developer tools (JSON).
backup.moduleCustomersDesc: Profiles, phone numbers, addresses, account type and lifetime totals.
backup.moduleInventoryDesc: One collection holds phones, accessories and repair parts: stock, prices, costs, SKUs, supplier and location.
backup.moduleDebtsDesc: Every credit sale and payment: amount, paid, remaining, due date, and the ticket or invoice it belongs to.
backup.moduleRepairsDesc: Ticket numbers, devices, IMEI, diagnostics, status, costs and assigned technician.
backup.moduleTransactionsDesc: Invoices, totals, payment status, customer and cashier.
backup.modulePurchaseOrdersDesc: Supplier orders, order dates, status and total cost.
backup.moduleEodDesc: Sealed daily totals: sales, cash, profit and who closed the day.
backup.restoreDesc: Re-apply a snapshot file to the live database. A restore writes only the documents it contains — it never deletes anything.
backup.invalidFileFallback: This file could not be read as a backup.
backup.appendOnlyWarning: Log collections only accept new documents. Their existing entries stay untouched, and rejected writes appear in the report.
backup.noCollectionsSelected: Select at least one dataset to restore.
backup.confirmBody: {{collections}} collections and {{documents}} documents will be written back to the live database. This cannot be undone — export a fresh backup of the current state first.
backup.confirmOverwrite: Overwrite mode is selected: live edits to these documents will be lost.
backup.restoreFailedDesc: The restore could not be completed.
backup.guidelinesTitle: Disaster Recovery Guidelines for Store Owners
backup.guidelineFrequency: Frequency: export a full backup at the end of every week and before any inventory reconciliation.
backup.guidelineStorage: Storage: keep the downloaded file on a separate drive or an encrypted cloud folder, not only on this workstation.
backup.guidelinePrivacy: Privacy: backups contain customer phone numbers, device lock codes and financial balances. Never share them with unauthorized personnel.
backup.guidelineRestore: Restore: a backup that reported a failed collection is incomplete — export again before relying on it.
